sub_sector.value: Coil coating; hot-dip galvanizing; metal finishing

manufacturing_type.detail: Coats and processes metal coils, hot-dip galvanizes fabricated steel, and applies specialized surface finishes.

production_model.detail: Coating and finishing services meet customer performance requirements and project schedules.

product_complexity.detail: Engineered coil coatings and tailored surface finishes improve durability and appearance, while galvanizing protects fabricated steel from corrosion.

production_role.detail: Provides independent coil coating, fabricated-steel galvanizing, and metal finishing services for customers.

end_market_exposure.detail: Serves buildings, industrial equipment, transportation infrastructure, energy utilities, consumer products, agricultural facilities, and communications infrastructure.

notes: The make-to-order classification is inferred from customer projects and tailored finishing services.
